Index: /tmp/opencode/kbtest2.sh
===================================================================
--- /tmp/opencode/kbtest2.sh
+++ /tmp/opencode/kbtest2.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+# Слой X: доходит ли KeyPress до алacритти (xev) и какие keycode/keysym/state.
+LOG=/tmp/opencode/xev.log; rm -f "$LOG"
+pre=$(xdotool search --class Alacritty 2>/dev/null | sort)
+alacritty --class kbprobe -e sh -c "xev | grep -E 'keycode|keysym|state' > $LOG 2>&1" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
+wid=""
+for i in $(seq 1 24); do
+  post=$(xdotool search --class Alacritty 2>/dev/null | sort)
+  wid=$(comm -13 <(echo "$pre") <(echo "$post") | head -1)
+  [ -n "$wid" ] && break
+  sleep 0.5
+done
+[ -z "$wid" ] && { echo "NO_WINDOW"; exit 1; }
+xdotool windowactivate --sync "$wid"; sleep 0.8
+setxkbmap -layout us; sleep 0.3
+xdotool key a;      sleep 0.6   # keycode 38, keysym a
+setxkbmap -layout ru; sleep 0.3
+xdotool key Cyrillic_ef; sleep 0.6   # keycode 38, keysym Cyrillic_EF
+xdotool key ctrl+Cyrillic_de; sleep 0.6 # keycode 38+ctrl при RU
+setxkbmap -layout us,ru -option grp:alt_shift_toggle
+sleep 0.3
+xdotool windowkill "$wid" 2>/dev/null
+sleep 0.2
+echo "=== xev (keycode/keysym/state) ==="
+grep -E "KeyPress|keycode|keysym" "$LOG" | grep -v "KeyRelease" | head -30
